title: Cucurbitane Glycosides and Their Potential Anti-Inflammatory Activities from Hemsleya chinensis Tubers.
authors: Chi, Jun; Li, Miaomiao; Lian, Feihe; Li, Yixiao; Dai, Liping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究葫芦烷糖苷的抗炎活性及分子对接，对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Hemsleya chinensis tubers, abundantly produced in southwestern China, are commonly used as a folk medicine that excel in anti-inflammation to treat enteritis, bronchitis, and tonsillitis. In this study, three previously undescribed cucurbitane glycosides, hemchinins G-H (1-3), that were characterized by the presence of four glucose substitutions, as well as eleven ones with one to three beta-glucoses, were isolated from the tubers of H. chinensis. The structures were confirmed using comprehensive UV, IR, HR-ESI-MS, and NMR analyses, and absolute configurations were determined through a comparison of calculated and experimental ECD after acid hydrolysis. Compounds 1-3 showed NO inhibition effects on LPS-induced RAW 264.7 cells. Finally, molecular docking analyses were conducted to obtain the affinities of the isolated cucurbitane glycosides and our previously reported 19 cucurbitane triterpenes, focusing on targets involved in anti-inflammatory effects. The results indicated that they showed high docking scores of affinities with the proteins in the NF-kappaB, AMPK, and Nrf2 signaling pathways. Among them, cucurbitane triterpenes with sugar moiety substitution at C-3 and C-26/27 showed better affinity ability. The findings can provide insights into the anti-inflammatory mechanisms of this species and facilitate the development of novel therapeutic agents.
abstract_zh: 雪胆（Hemsleya chinensis）块茎盛产于中国西南地区，常作为民间药物使用，具有优异的抗炎作用，用于治疗肠炎、支气管炎和扁桃体炎。本研究从雪胆块茎中分离出三种此前未描述的葫芦烷型糖苷，即hemchinins G-H（1-3），其特征为具有四个葡萄糖取代基，以及十一种含有一至三个β-葡萄糖的化合物。通过综合UV、IR、HR-ESI-MS和NMR分析确认了结构，并通过酸水解后计算与实验ECD的比较确定了绝对构型。化合物1-3对LPS诱导的RAW 264.7细胞表现出NO抑制效应。最后，进行了分子对接分析，以评估所分离的葫芦烷型糖苷及我们先前报道的19种葫芦烷型三萜的亲和力，重点关注参与抗炎作用的靶点。结果表明，它们与NF-kappaB、AMPK和Nrf2信号通路中的蛋白质显示出高对接亲和力得分。其中，在C-3和C-26/27位具有糖基取代的葫芦烷型三萜表现出更好的亲和能力。这些发现可为该物种的抗炎机制提供见解，并促进新型治疗药物的开发。
